hypotheses.J1_joint_chart_beats_position_collapsed_: At rank 64, the joint sequence-residual chart exceeds the position-collapsed Fisher chart by at least 0.10 for every new target-boundary pair.
hypotheses.J2_joint_rank64_is_causally_useful: The joint rank-64 chart preserves at least 85% final Fisher-response fidelity for every new target-boundary pair.
hypotheses.J3_joint_rank128_is_high_fidelity: The joint rank-128 chart preserves at least 95% final Fisher-response fidelity for every new target-boundary pair.
hypotheses.J4_joint_chart_is_sampling_stable: Independent-tail leading-64 joint charts have mean squared canonical cosine at least 0.70 in every context and boundary.
hypotheses.J5_cross_position_structure_generalizes_: J1 and J2 hold independently for all three fixed new targets.
